scope: Human-like model visual judgment of actual Godot captures, not an objective likeness or style score.
improvements: The hard narrow central visor stripe is replaced by one broad soft purple reflection. Continuous purple glass and its accepted lower facet seam remain readable; no dark W split or eye-pair was introduced.
Cap, chest, back, forearm and leg plates use broader soft highlights with quieter fine bright-edge tracing. Long thin crack/scratch emphasis was reduced.
Accepted black horizontal brow, blue brow block, sloped chin, two chest ports, layered abdomen, blue thigh blocks and four blue back panels retain their current mapped location and identity.
mapping_observations: No newly shifted visor/chest openings or obvious new seam break seen in inspected front/side/rear and posed captures. Exact mesh/UV invariants are separately checked numerically; image observations do not substitute for that check.
residual_limits: Chest strap buckles and the chin contact edge still have brighter painted outlines than the broad original plate shading; this is a remaining art decision, not solved by lower UV-change percentages.
The accepted low-poly shell, large side-ear mass and plane transitions remain. Surface painting cannot replace a physical silhouette or thickness.
This pass unifies rendering style while preserving design. It does not add the larger shoulder/back signatures needed to make this a clearly separate armor identity from original Viper.
bitmap_editing: Five built-in image_gen outputs copied byte-for-byte into the game. No programmatic recolor, blur, resize, crop or composition was performed.
